venira.output_kind: affected[] {id, distance, path, confidence}, summary {affected_files, affected_symbols, tests_affected}, unresolved[].
venira.speed_profile: medium; reuses the dependency index (5 s cache, invalidated on writes), BFS bounded by depth. No network.
venira.use_when: you are about to rename or change something and need which files to read and which tests to run.

description:
List the files and symbols affected by changing given files or symbols (direction: dependents, dependencies or both). At least one of files/symbols; a symbol seed takes {name, relative_path} (file is an alias).
Use when: you are about to rename or change something and need which files to read and which tests to run.
Avoid when: you want the whole graph (project_dependency_graph).
Output: affected[] {id, distance, path, confidence}, summary {affected_files, affected_symbols, tests_affected}, unresolved[].

files.description: Workspace paths you plan to edit. At least one of files/symbols is required.

include_tests.description: 1 includes test files (default) and counts them in tests_affected.

symbols.description: Symbols you plan to rename/change; pass a name, or {name, relative_path} (or {name, file}) when the name is ambiguous. At least one of files/symbols is required.

file.description: Alias of relative_path (relative_path wins when both are given).

relative_path.description: File the symbol is declared in; preferred over file.

name: project_change_impact
title: Change impact
